name: Darjeeling
description: Hill town in the Darjeeling Himalaya known for tea gardens, the UNESCO-listed Darjeeling Himalayan Railway and views towards Kangchenjunga.

images.alt: Darjeeling railway station with narrow-gauge steam locomotives
Ropeway cabin above tea gardens near Darjeeling
images.credit: Jyoti PN via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 (publisher-attested)
images.verificationNote: Licence attested by the publisher; Commons file page not independently located.

accessibility: Reachable by road from Siliguri / Bagdogra; hill roads are slow and weather-dependent.
safety: Hill roads can be affected by landslides in monsoon. Use registered transport and check local advisories.
weatherNote: Live weather requires a configured provider; this build does not display forecast data. Check a weather service before travel.

name: Sandakphu
